name: application-avatar-group
title: Avatar Group
description: Overlapping cluster of avatars with a typed member list and an automatic "+N" overflow chip for collaborators, assignees, or attendees.
useWhen: Showing who is on a team, thread, or record without listing every name.
You have a real list of members and want overflow beyond a max count collapsed automatically.
Compact visual density matters more than showing every member at once.
avoidWhen: Only one person needs to be shown — use a single avatar instead.
Every member needs a visible name or role alongside their image — use a list instead.
You need rich per-member interaction (click to open profile, remove member) — build a dedicated list/menu instead.
responsiveBehavior: The cluster is an inline-flex block sized to its content; it does not reflow — reduce `max` at narrow widths if space is constrained.
accessibility: The group wrapper carries an aria-label naming the members, including any collapsed into the overflow chip.
Each avatar carries a title attribute with the member's full name; image avatars also set alt text to the name.
The overflow chip's title lists every hidden member's name so the full roster is still discoverable.

variants.title: Avatar group
variants.description: Four overlapping initials avatars plus a "+3" overflow chip on a light surface.
accessibility: Ring color separates overlapping avatars from each other and from the page background.

variants.title: Avatar group (Dark)
variants.description: Four overlapping initials avatars plus a "+3" overflow chip adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Initials and overflow-chip text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
